change: Two lazy cached deferred plans per in-flight slot. Select G-buffer-only when shadowPendingMask is zero; retain full shadow updates, including empty clear-only submissions, otherwise. Both plans retire under existing fence/device-idle lifecycle before target release.
scope: Vulkan backend only; no public API, ECS, persistent format, module-boundary or cross-domain lifecycle changes; no architecture exceptions.

method.host: shared AMD EPYC 9V74 VM; four CPU quota
method.order: alternating before/final; no concurrent builds or tests during measurements
method.aggregation: median of per-run frame means; tail percentiles are medians of per-run percentiles
method.limits: Not physical GPU throughput or statistical significance. Shadow-control timings are short-run controls. Does not skip individual idle layers when other shadow updates are pending.

validation.isolatedRuntimeTests: 5 cases, 331 assertions passed: idle/update/empty-clear/resize shadow transitions, late G-buffer resize/readback, Hybrid availability/GPU-driven fallback, core-lighting parity, sparse-skin CPU reference

vulkanValidation.notes: Layer emitted unused-vertex-attribute performance warnings; no VUID or synchronization errors.
